steps.name: 1-boot
steps.eval: JSON.stringify({nestUI: typeof NestUI, rows: document.querySelectorAll('table tbody tr').length, copyBtns: document.querySelectorAll('[onclick*="copyCode"]').length, toggleBtns: document.querySelectorAll('[onclick*="toggleCode"]').length, tableText: document.body.innerText.replace(/\s+/g,' ').slice(0,200)})

steps.name: 3-create-state
steps.eval: (function(){ var m=document.getElementById('create-modal'); var ids=[]; m.querySelectorAll('input,select,textarea').forEach(function(e){ if(e.id) ids.push(e.id); }); return JSON.stringify({visible: !m.classList.contains('hidden'), fields: ids, text: m.innerText.replace(/\s+/g,' ').slice(0,160)}); })()

steps.name: 6-copy-result
steps.eval: (function(){ var t=[]; document.querySelectorAll('.nx-toast-text').forEach(function(e){ t.push(e.textContent.trim().slice(0,120)); }); return JSON.stringify({toasts:t, hasClipboard: !!(navigator.clipboard && navigator.clipboard.writeText)}); })()
